title: Hussainan waah Hussainan waah Hussaina
body:
Hussainan Wah, Hussainan Wah Hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
Ala Noor Laqa……………………… Hussainan Wah, Hussainan Wah Hussaina
Wa Ala Saide Shaheede Karbalai
<<MINI>>
Hussainan Wah, Hussainan Wah Hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo Ummi Fatema Abi Ali Yoon
Faqala Youm Ala Ya Khoume Inni
<<MINI>>
Hussain Hussain Hussain Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
A Azdami Ke Fatema
Ayat Badashte Karbala
Gareebe Nainava Hussain
Shaheede Karbala Hussain
<<MINI>>
Hussain Hussain Hussain Hussain
